final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS net_rate FROM per_order) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(p.avg_net_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_rate - b.net_rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_rate > b.net_rate
